scope: 124 unique method x dataset pairs: 116 legacy numerical comparisons and 8 newly documented GC4NC pairs, across 19 methods and 7 datasets.
unit: Equal weight per unique method x dataset pair; average its matched node-budget settings or saved edge graphs before thresholding.
threshold_rule: strict <; only pairs with published numerical references enter either numerator or denominator; no completion credits
exclusions: Clustering, published-only GEOM/SFGC rows, whole-graph baselines and other undeclared/unreferenced cells remain excluded. The eight newly documented GC4NC cells are now included.
protocol_scope: Cumulative frozen reruns with method-specific provenance replay, validation-selected HPO, and historical baselines; not a single uniform new run of the current checkout. Per-pair evaluation_profile identifies adopted reruns; historical_frozen denotes inherited results. The eight added pairs share their underlying archived observations with the revised GC4NC tables and are not independent replication runs.

reference_corrections.rule: Where GC4NC v3 main-text Table 1 and Appendix Table 9 disagree, Table 1 is authoritative; the Table 9 Pubmed 0.02% K-Center cell (79.18) is a transcription error and belongs to TSpanner (absent from Table 1).
evidence: arXiv 2406.16715v3 Table 1, Pubmed 0.02%: Herding 62.91, K-Center 62.91, Averaging 75.60 (checked live 2026-11-01)
Table 9 Pubmed 0.02%: K-Center 79.18±0.2 (above Whole 78.6), TSpanner 62.91±1.5 (duplicate of Herding), Averaging 74.09±0.6
